AFTE.name: After
AFTE.definition: Specifies that the transaction/instruction is to be executed after the linked transaction/instruction.

WITH.name: With
WITH.definition: Specifies that the transaction/instruction is to be executed with the linked transaction/instruction.

BEFO.name: Before
BEFO.definition: Specifies that the transaction/instruction is to be executed before the linked transaction/instruction.

INFO.name: Information
INFO.definition: Specifies that the transactions/instructions are linked for information purposes only.
